messages.subject: UT Austin Student Highly Interested in Aeris Partners' Summer 2025 Internship
messages.body:
Hello Aeris Recruiting Team,

I hope this email finds you well. I am emailing to emphasize my interest in
recruiting at Aeris Partners for the Summer Analyst 2025 Program. I am
from Los Angeles, and I'm now studying Economics and Business at the
University of Texas - Austin. I'm sure your firm doesn't receive many
applications from UT students, if any at all, so I wanted to send this
email to reaffirm my interest in Aeris, having already submitted my online
application.

A week ago, a close friend of mine studying at USC Marshall shared with me
that Aeris had directly reached out to him for recruitment purposes. This
conversation piqued my interest in your firm. I have since spent some time
learning more about Aeris Partners. My interest is twofold:

1) I am particularly interested in boutique tech banks. Aeries stands out
as a SaaS M&A bank as I believe very strongly in the future of the SaaS
industry.
2) Through learning more about your firm through talking to my buddy who
had a coffee chat with Aeris and your website, it is abundantly clear that
your firm places a tremendous emphasis on company culture and personal
fit, transcending beyond the superficial culture narrative of most banks.
This is very unique to your firm and genuinely appeals to me.

I hope I have demonstrated my sincere interest in your firm and you
consider my application. I also attached my resume below.

Best,
Jonathan Nachman

Hi Jonathan,

Thank you for your interest in Aeris Partners! I have escalated your application in the review process based on your email below, so thank you for following up. If you have not heard from us on any potential next steps by Tuesday, please feel free to reconnect with me and I’ll let you know of any status updates. We appreciate your patience as we navigate through an unprecedented volume of applications this cycle!

Best,
Paige
